main_text.p: inquisitione, monens, vt potius sese quotidie ad Christi aduentum religiosè comparent. Tandem etiam breuissimas de variis reb. admonitiones attexit.
main_text.head: Σύνοψις τυπικὴ[?]
main_text.l: Paulus in Epistola ad Thessal: prima, post salutationem, Thessalonicenses tum

p.i: Cap. I. Habet 1. Salutationem v.1. 11 Narrationem trimembrem: primò enim narrat quid quotidie propter Thessalonicenses agat, nempe quod Deo agat gratias pro donis spiritualibus in ipsos collatis: quorum etiam fontem indicat, videlicet electionem Dei: v. 2. 3.4. Deinde eâ occasione suum apud eos functum ministerium commendat ab ad-iuncta efficacia, v.5. Postremò, quomodo Thessalonicenses se gesserint, quum Paulus apud ipsos Euangelium praedicaret: nempe quod doctrinâ illam coelestem promte & alacriter amplexi sint fide: v.6. quod ipsum postea amplificat ex euentis, videlicet imitatione aliorum qui scilicet ipsos sint imitati, v.7. & fama fidei ipsorum apud complures diffusâ, v.8.

page.notes: The Greek heading is set in a small, spaced type and its letters are hard to read; the reading Σύνοψις τυπικὴ is a best guess and is marked [?]. The diagram's bracket structure was read from the drawing; levels follow the braces. "ipsorum" is a label beside the bracket, and "c.3." sits beside the bracket of the two sub-items. The "11" after v.1. is printed as shown and may be a printing error. The reference "9.10. vbi" stands at the right below the text block and is set as a foot line.
